Interface AlertBroadcastManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlertBroadcastManagerImpl
public interface AlertBroadcastManager
Public API for pushing real-time alerts to connected clients. Backs the TASK_UPDATED_EVENT, TASK_ASSIGNED_EVENT, TASK_STATUS_UPDATED_EVENT, MILESTONE_UPDATED_EVENT server-originated websocket events. Called internally by other modules (e.g. task) when something alert-worthy happens.
